description: This file contains Kotlin code for configuring Kotlin and Android build options within a Gradle build script. It defines functions to set compile SDK versions, Java compatibility, and Kotlin compiler options, specifically targeting Android projects and general JVM projects.

methods.name: configureKotlinAndroid
methods.description: Configures Kotlin options for Android projects, including SDK versions and dependencies.

methods.name: configureKotlinJvm
methods.description: Configures Kotlin options for JVM projects, setting Java compatibility and other compiler options.

methods.name: configureKotlin
methods.description: A generic inline function to configure Kotlin compiler options for different Kotlin project extensions.
